svg.title: Deep Trader - interpreted silhouette
svg.desc: Traders and Gunboats (2024), printed 82-83, PDF 83-84. Combined two-deck envelope follows larger lower deck and retains twin rounded forward pods with open centre recess, parallel cargo body and wide rear drive blocks. Upper deck aligns at matching beam/grid scale and is contained. Illustration corroborates forked Marava-derived hull. Detached turrets and internal docking/cargo borders excluded.
